items.source: Implementation of the DataBuffer interface that can wrap a Jetty Content.Chunk. Typically constructed with JettyDataBufferFactory.
items.translation: 实现 `DataBuffer` 接口，可包装 Jetty `Content.Chunk`。通常由 JettyDataBufferFactory 构建。

items.source: Return the DataBufferFactory that created this buffer.
items.translation: 返回创建此缓冲区的DataBufferFactory。

items.source: Return true if this buffer is allocated; false if it has been deallocated.
items.translation: 如果此缓冲区已分配，则返回true；如果它已被释放，则返回false。

items.source: Write one or more ByteBuffer to this buffer, starting at the current writing position.
items.translation: 向此缓冲区写入一个或多个ByteBuffer（java.nio 中的类或接口），从当前写入位置开始。

items.source: Read at most length bytes of this buffer into the specified destination, starting at the current reading position of this buffer.
items.translation: 读取此缓冲区中从当前读取位置开始的至多 `length` 字节到指定的目标。

items.source: Copies the given length from this data buffer into the given destination ByteBuffer, beginning at the given source position, and the given destination position in the destination byte buffer.
items.translation: 从该数据缓冲区复制给定长度的内容到指定的目标 `ByteBuffer`，起始位置为给定的源位置，并在目标字节缓冲区的指定位置开始。

items.source: Write at most length bytes of the given source into this buffer, starting at the current writing position of this buffer.
items.translation: 将给定的源数据中至多 `length` 个字节写入此缓冲区，从该缓冲区的当前写入位置开始。

items.source: Return the number of bytes that this buffer can contain.
items.translation: 返回该缓冲区可容纳的字节数。

items.source: Read a single byte at the given index from this data buffer.
items.translation: 从该数据缓冲区中读取给定索引处的单个字节。

items.source:
Return the index of the first byte in this buffer that matches
the given predicate.
items.translation: 返回此缓冲区中匹配给定谓词的第一个字节的索引。

items.source:
Return the index of the last byte in this buffer that matches
the given predicate.
items.translation: 返回此缓冲区中匹配给定谓词的最后一个字节的索引。

items.source: Read a single byte from the current reading position from this data buffer.
items.translation: 从当前读取位置读取此数据缓冲区中的一个字节。

items.source:
Read this buffer's data into the specified destination, starting at the current
reading position of this buffer.
items.translation: 将此缓冲区的数据从当前读取位置读入指定的目标。

items.source: Return the number of bytes that can be read from this data buffer.
items.translation: 返回从此数据缓冲区可读的字节数。

items.source: Return the position from which this buffer will read.
items.translation: 返回该缓冲区将读取的位置。

items.source: Set the position from which this buffer will read.
items.translation: 设置该缓冲区将读取的位置。

items.source:
Decrease the reference count for this buffer by one,
and deallocate it once the count reaches zero.
items.translation: 将此缓冲区的引用计数减一，并在计数达到零时释放它。

items.source: Increase the reference count for this buffer by one.
items.translation: 将此缓冲区的引用计数增加一。

items.source: Return a part of this buffer's data as a String using the specified charset.
items.translation: 使用指定的字符集将此缓冲区的数据部分返回为 String。

items.source: Associate the given hint with the data buffer for debugging purposes.
items.translation: 将给定的提示关联到数据缓冲区，用于调试目的。

items.source: Return the number of bytes that can be written to this data buffer.
items.translation: 返回可写入此数据缓冲区的字节数。

items.source: Write a single byte into this buffer at the current writing position.
items.translation: 在当前写入位置向此缓冲区写入一个字节。

items.source:
Write the given source into this buffer, starting at the current writing
position of this buffer.
items.translation: 将此源写入该缓冲区，从该缓冲区的当前写入位置开始。

items.source: Return the position to which this buffer will write.
items.translation: 返回该缓冲区将写入的位置。

items.source: Set the position to which this buffer will write.
items.translation: 设置此缓冲区将写入的位置。

items.source: The read and write position of the returned buffer are truncated to fit within the buffers capacity if necessary. The positions of this buffer are set to 0 if they are smaller than index.
items.translation: 返回缓冲区的读和写位置在必要时会被截断以适配缓冲区的容量。如果这些位置小于index，则将其设置为0。

items.source: Note that this method will not call DataBufferUtils.retain(DataBuffer) on the resulting slice: the reference count will not be increased.
items.translation: 注意，此方法不会在生成的切片上调用 DataBufferUtils.retain(DataBuffer)：引用计数将不会增加。

items.source: Data that precedes the index will be returned in a new buffer, while this buffer will contain data that follows after index. Memory between the two buffers is shared, but independent and cannot overlap (unlike slice).
items.translation: 在 `index` 之前的数据将返回到一个新缓冲区中，而该缓冲区将包含 `index` 之后的数据。两个缓冲区之间的内存是共享的，但是独立的且不能重叠（不同于slice）。

items.source:
If the new capacity is lower than the current capacity, the contents
of this buffer will be truncated. If the new capacity is higher than
the current capacity, it will be expanded.
items.translation: 如果新容量低于当前容量，此缓冲区的內容将被截断。如果新容量高于当前容量，它将被扩展。

items.source: Expose this buffer's bytes as a ByteBuffer. Data between this DataBuffer and the returned ByteBuffer is shared; though changes in the returned buffer's position will not be reflected in the reading nor writing position of this data buffer.
items.translation: 将此缓冲区的字节暴露为 ByteBuffer。此 DataBuffer 与返回的 ByteBuffer 之间的数据是共享的；尽管对返回缓冲区的 position 所做的更改不会反映在此数据缓冲区的读取或写入位置中。

items.source: Expose a subsequence of this buffer's bytes as a ByteBuffer. Data between this DataBuffer and the returned ByteBuffer is shared; though changes in the returned buffer's position will not be reflected in the reading nor writing position of this data buffer.
items.translation: 将此缓冲区的字节子序列暴露为 ByteBuffer。此 DataBuffer 与返回的 ByteBuffer 之间的数据是共享的；尽管对返回缓冲区的 position 所做的更改不会反映在此数据缓冲区的读取或写入位置中。

items.source: Returns a ByteBuffer representation of a subsequence of this buffer's bytes. Data between this DataBuffer and the returned ByteBuffer is not shared.
items.translation: 返回此缓冲区字节子序列的ByteBuffer表示形式。此DataBuffer与返回的ByteBuffer之间的数据不共享。

items.source: Ensure that the current buffer has enough DataBuffer.writableByteCount() to write the amount of data given as an argument.
items.translation: 确保当前缓冲区具有足够的 `DataBuffer.writableByteCount()` 来写入作为参数给出的数据量。

items.source: Returns a closeable iterator over each ByteBuffer in this data buffer that can be read.
items.translation: 返回一个可关闭的迭代器，用于遍历此数据缓冲区中每个可读的 ByteBuffer。

items.source: Returns a closeable iterator over each ByteBuffer in this data buffer that can be written to.
items.translation: 返回一个可关闭的迭代器，遍历此数据缓冲区中每个可以写入的ByteBuffer。

items.source: Ensure that the current buffer has enough DataBuffer.writableByteCount() to write the amount of data given as an argument. If not, the missing capacity will be added to the buffer.
items.translation: 确保当前缓冲区具有足够的 DataBuffer.writableByteCount() 来写入作为参数给出的数据量。如果没有，则会将缺少的容量添加到缓冲区中。
